entries.en:
Petyr Winsome wishes you to participate in one of the monster-culling operations taking place at Three-malm Bend in middle La Noscea and Quarterstone in western La Noscea, and regale him with an account of your firsthand experience.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: During your efforts to whittle down the rising numbers of monstrous wildlife, you encounter an enigmatic knight who introduces herself as “Lightning.” After retrieving an odd parcel she left behind after the battle, you return to Limsa Lominsa to share your experiences with Petyr Winsome. At the reporter's insistence, you both tear open the strange parcel to reveal gloves of highly unusual design. Petyr, more than pleased with your contribution to his article, gladly places the handwear into your keeping. You are left wondering, however, who Lightning truly is, and whence the warrior has come.
entries.fr: Petyr Winsome a ouvert <frnoun(Item,2,　5942,1,1)> laissé par la guerrière. Il contenait un équipement inconnu, qu'il vous a remis tout en vous remerciant de l'avoir aidé pour son article. Mais qui est donc cette mystérieuse “Lightning”<nbsp>?
entries.ja: ピーター・ウィンソムと共に<sheet(Item,　5942,0)>の中身を確認したところ、見たこともない形の武具が入っていた。彼は取材の内容に満足し、入っていた武具を冒険者に返した。謎めいた武器を繰る、凄腕の女騎士ライトニング……彼女は何者なのだろうか？

entries.en: Greetings, friend. I am Petyr Winsome, reporter for the <italic(1)>Harbor Herald<italic(0)>. Could you spare a moment to aid me with an article I hope to pen?
entries.macro: Greetings, friend. I am Petyr Winsome, reporter for the <italic(1)>Harbor Herald<italic(0)>. Could you spare a moment to aid me with an article I hope to pen?
entries.fr: Salutations, <if(gnum4,ma belle amie,mon bel ami)><nbsp>! Je suis Petyr Winsome, le célèbre journaliste du Limséen Averti. Sans transition, j'aimerais vous demander une faveur. Si ça ne vous dérange pas, je voudrais que vous m'aidiez à rédiger un article.
entries.ja:
私の名は、ピーター・ウィンソム。
海都の人気情報誌「ハーバーヘラルド」の記者です。
いきなりですが、冒険者さんを取材してもかまいませんか？

entries.en: It is nothing scandalous or unseemly, I assure you. I simply wish to interview an adventurer about <if(gnum4,her,his)> firsthand experiences dealing with the recent and inexplicable profusion of monstrous wildlife beyond the city gates.
entries.macro: It is nothing scandalous or unseemly, I assure you. I simply wish to interview an adventurer about <if(gnum4,her,his)> firsthand experiences dealing with the recent and inexplicable profusion of monstrous wildlife beyond the city gates.
entries.fr: Ne vous en faites pas, ce n'est rien de bien compliqué. Je cherche juste à recueillir le témoignage de personnes qui ont l'expérience du combat sur le terrain.
entries.ja:
いえいえ、何も難しいことではありません。
最近、増えつつある魔物の討伐について、
現場の生の声を聞かせてくれるだけでいいのですから。

entries.en:
I am especially curious about the spawning megalocrabs out at Three-malm Bend, and a particularly ravenous dodo dubbed Gertrude running rampant at Quarterstone. Should you encounter any of these creatures, I would greatly appreciate aught you might share with me!
...And though I doubt not your integrity, would you mind returning with some physical evidence of your efforts? I have a reputation as a seeker of truth to maintain, you understand!

entries.en: A delight to speak with you again, adventurer. So, tell me: have you discovered aught to share with the <italic(1)>Harbor Herald<italic(0)>'s readership? Any tales to mesmerize─and inform, of course─the masses? Hm?

entries.fr: Ah, c'est vous<nbsp>! Alors<nbsp>? Avez-vous des in<->for<->ma<->tions croustillantes à... Hum<nbsp>? Quoi<nbsp>?

どうも、冒険者さん。無事に戻られましたね。
さっそく魔物討伐の感想を取材させてください。
……おや、何かあったのですか？

……何ですって？
見知らぬ、女騎士が現れたのですか？
そこにこの包みが……。

entries.en: Allow me to confirm the facts. A puissant and powerful woman in exotic raiment appears, introducing herself as “Lightning.” And after the battle is won, she vanishes like a bolt of the very stuff for which she was named.
entries.fr: Je vois, je vois... Une guerrière de talent appelée Lightning... drôle de nom, si vous voulez mon avis. Ça explique peut-être pourquoi elle a disparu dans un éclair de lumière une fois tous les monstres vaincus.
entries.ja:
ふむふむ……「ライトニング」と名乗る、
凄腕の女騎士が現れた……と。
そして、魔物を倒すと、光と共に消え去った……。

entries.en: Finally, left in her blinding wake, you find what can be described as naught else but an “otherworldly” package. <italic(1)>Incredible<italic(0)>! I say we peel back the wrapping and have a peek at what's inside!

entries.fr: Et après son passage, vous dites avoir trouvé ce curieux paquet. Voilà qui est très intrigant<nbsp>! Vous devriez l'ouvrir sans plus tarder<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
なるほど……それで、その跡に残されていたのが、
この「異国風の包み」だというのですね？
興味深い、さっそく開けてみましょう！

entries.en: ...I have never before seen such craftsmanship. I imagine even the famed artisans of Gridania would struggle to reproduce this degree of quality.
entries.fr: Hmmm... Je n'ai jamais vu d'équipement de ce type auparavant. Je suis sûr que peu de tanneurs à Gridania peuvent atteindre ce niveau de perfection.
entries.ja:
……これは、見たこともない形の武具ですね。
これほど見事な造形の武具を作るのは、革細工の技に優れた、
グリダニアの職人でさえ難しいでしょう。

entries.en: A mysterious knight of unknown origin wielding a weapon of equally enigmatic design. Yes, this shall become a most interesting article indeed. Your contribution has been invaluable!
entries.fr: Une guerrière énigmatique, manipulant une épée étrange... c'est tout à fait passionnant<nbsp>! Je pense que ça fera un bon article, tout ça. Merci de votre aide<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
謎めいた未知の武器を操る、異邦の女騎士……
ふむふむ、これはいい記事が書けそうです。
取材させてくださって、ありがとうございました！

entries.en: With your profession in mind, I believe the contents of this parcel are best left in your hands. After all, I have need of no other accoutrements but my mighty quill!
entries.fr: ... Vous savez quoi<nbsp>? Je vais vous laisser garder ces gants. Ils vous seront cer<->tai<->ne<->ment plus utiles qu'à moi. Après tout, la seule arme que je manie c'est la plume, et elle est plus forte que l'épée, comme on dit<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
この武具は、魔物と戦う冒険者さんがお持ちください。
そのほうがお役に立つでしょうからね。
それに、私の武器は、このペンですから！
